The .csv files in files/ come from the test-document corpus of xberg (td/vendored/docling), which vendors test data of docling
(https://github.com/DS4SD/docling), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 International Business Machines, copied unmodified.
The other csv fixtures are synthesised here from cases in xberg's Rust tests (issue_150_*, issue_164_*, encoding_extraction.rs). Sizes in bytes:
